name: E-09: § rung rejects requires a rung delimiter — undelimited rejects are unenforced
task_prompt:
Derive the formalization ladder for this governing goal:

'Validate that an email address string contains exactly one @ symbol with non-empty local and domain parts.'

Produce the full derivation ladder from §1 through ## Formalization, writing '§ rung rejects: [quoted phrase]' before each rung after the first. Stop after § formalization complete.
eval_gate: PASS if every '§ rung rejects:' line is followed immediately by a quoted phrase that appears verbatim as a substring of the immediately preceding rung's text (check manually: the quoted phrase must be findable word-for-word in the prior rung). FAIL if any '§ rung rejects:' value is a paraphrase or summary rather than a verbatim substring, or if '§ rung rejects:' appears without a clear rung boundary marker separating it from the prior rung.
